name: Henri Alvin Eustace
source:
Henri is one of the seniors in St. Jean-Marie Academy. He is often absent in his classes and just doing whatever he wants to do inside the school.
At first, he found Eimi really annoying and for him, love letters are obsolete. He even hates Eimi for being so childish all the time.
translation:
Henri is one of the seniors in St. Jean-Marie Academy. He is often absent in his classes and just doing whatever he wants to do inside the school.
At first, he found Eimi really annoying and for him, love letters are obsolete. He even hates Eimi for being so childish all the time.
